name: fig_a1_random_2d
caption: Random 2-D mask porosity accuracy: relative error vs target porosity. All cases well below 15% threshold.

name: fig_a3_analytical
caption: Analytical geometry porosity: computed (voxelized) vs analytical values for sphere, cylinder, and ellipsoid. Errors are below 0.05%.

name: fig_a4_convergence
caption: Porosity convergence: sphere (p≈1.84) and cylinder (p≈1.63) both show >1st order convergence. Errors well below 15% threshold at all resolutions.

name: fig_a5_sigma
caption: Sigma sensitivity: porosity accuracy remains excellent across all Gaussian correlation lengths. The quantile-based thresholding ensures exact porosity regardless of sigma.
